Description
The Commission is seeking one or more qualified marketing and communications partners to establish an on-call services pool. The selected Company(ies) will collaborate with the Airport on both long-term strategic planning and targeted individual projects to develop and execute strategies that raise public awareness, strengthen its reputation, and drive revenue. Services include but are not limited to public relations, strategic communications, issues and risk management, crisis communications, branding, research, digital and social media, marketing, media placement, and community relations.

Additionally, the Company(ies) will support and promote air service routes, parking, concessions, general airport services, construction updates, economic development initiatives, and special events, all while maintaining consistent messaging and branding, and perform other tasks as assigned by the Commission.
